seo.description: Portfolio of Rahul Prasad, a Computer Science student building clean, working software. Explore projects, skills, and contact information.

paragraphs: I am a Computer Science student who likes turning ideas into working products. I care about code that is honest about what it does, interfaces that work on a real phone, and explanations simple enough that someone else can maintain them.
I learn by building: small web applications, coursework projects, and side experiments that force me to read documentation, debug in earnest, and ship something another person can actually use.
Currently I am strengthening my frontend fundamentals and improving how I test and document my work.
